description: This file defines a singleton object ApiClient responsible for creating configured Retrofit instances to interact with backend APIs in a Kotlin frontend project. It includes methods for setting up Retrofit with Moshi for JSON parsing, OkHttp client with logging and timeouts, and provides factory methods for creating ProductApi and OrderApi service interfaces.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton object providing factory methods for creating Retrofit API service instances with predefined configurations.

methods.name: createRetrofit
methods.description: Creates and configures a Retrofit instance with a specified base URL, Moshi for JSON parsing, and OkHttp client with logging and timeouts.

methods.name: createProductApi
methods.description: Public method to create a ProductApi instance with an optional base URL.

methods.name: createOrderApi
methods.description: Public method to create an OrderApi instance with an optional base URL.
